'''''Verbena peruviana''''' (syn. ''Glandularia peruviana''), the '''Peruvian mock vervain''', is a species of flowering plant in the family [[Verbenaceae]].<ref>{{cite web |title=''Glandularia peruviana'' Peruvian mock vervain |url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/plants/353898/glandularia-peruviana/details |date=2021 |publisher=The Royal Horticultural Society |access-date=14 May 2021 |quote=Synonyms; ... ''Lippia chamaedrifolia'' }}</ref> It is native to Bolivia, southern Brazil,  northern Argentina, Paraguay, and Uruguay, but not Peru, and has been introduced to scattered locations elsewhere, including the former Czechoslovakia, the US state of Illinois, and the [[Leeward Islands]].<ref name="263236-2" >{{cite web |url=http://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:263236-2 |title=''Verbena peruviana'' (L.) Britton |author=<!--Not stated--> |website=Plants of the World Online |publisher=Board of Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew |access-date=14 May 2021 }}</ref> Under the synonym ''Glandularia peruviana'', its cultivar 'Balendpibi' (trade name {{tdes|Endurascape Pink Bicolor}}) has gained the [[Royal Horticultural Society]]'s [[Award of Garden Merit]].<ref>{{cite web |title=''Glandularia peruviana'' ENDURASCAPE PINK BICOLOR ('Balendpibi') |url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/plants/361035/glandularia-peruviana-endurascape-pink-bicolor-(-balendpibi-)/details |date=2021 |publisher=The Royal Horticultural Society |access-date=14 May 2021 }}</ref>
